05 · A TASTE OF THE RESULT

A signal is not the whole story.

SUMMER CLIMATE CONTEXT+0.628 °C / decadeJuly–September temperature24 complete seasons · nominal p = 0.0332

Nominal 95% interval: +0.050 to +1.205 °C/decade.

Williams Lake POWER grid context—not a regional mean or a cause of vegetation change.

MONTHLY LANDSCAPE GREENNESSInconclusive.101 valid / 187 missing months

Green = valid; dark = missing. Jan 2001–Dec 2024, left to right.

At least 80% QA-valid area required. No interpolation into a confident trend.

Greenness ≠ forest recovery.

Real BC Central Interior artifacts. Seasonal EVI is descriptive only; these related views are not independent corroboration.
